scope: Claude Code adapter ephemerality measurement only
hypothesis: The split ephemerality regression can be green while the subprocess boundary still exposes a durable writable HOME, so it cannot by itself establish temporary-home creation/removal or zero persistent-config write capability.
strongest_counterhypothesis: The real Claude binary honors --no-session-persistence and CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY strongly enough that retaining writable HOME is acceptable and no durable state is written. This remains plausible and is not falsified by a fake child; it requires exact Claude runtime filesystem observation.

bounded_experiment.reason_credit_withheld: No shared atomic macrocycle lease/id was available on this surface, so the global one-experiment coordination law cannot be proven.
bounded_experiment.method: A bounded standalone reproduction of the current ClaudeCodeInference subprocess boundary used the same environment allowlist and relevant CLI flags with a deterministic fake child. Parent HOME was a durable test directory; the fake child logged its received environment and wrote one marker beneath HOME/.claude. No provider secret lookup or network was performed.
limits: The standalone probe was a manually bounded reproduction of the relevant subprocess boundary, not execution of a clean exact Git checkout.
The child was fake Claude, therefore this does not prove that the real Claude binary writes persistent state under the current flags.
The executor was Debian, not the required exact Ubuntu acceptance runtime.

external_primary_evidence.claim: --no-session-persistence disables session persistence in print mode; --tools empty disables built-in tools; --strict-mcp-config without --mcp-config prevents MCP loading; --bare disables hook/skill/plugin/MCP/auto-memory/CLAUDE.md auto-discovery but leaves built-in tools unless separately restricted; --safe-mode disables customizations and auto-memory while authentication remains available, although managed settings policy still applies.
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR relocates settings, session history and plugins and, on Linux/Windows, credentials; therefore naive per-invocation config isolation can break or duplicate credential state.

inference: Current environment isolation is stronger than the old monolithic red in one dimension: ambient CLERK_SECRET_KEY did not cross the reproduced allowlist while admitted Anthropic auth did.
Current ephemerality evidence remains under-specified: writable inherited HOME is outside the temporary-home requirement in CLAUDE_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY_RECEIPT/v1.
Adding temporary HOME blindly is not yet justified because Claude subscription/OAuth credentials are stored under the Claude config path on Linux/Windows.
A stronger canonical design should measure actual persistent-config read/write behavior and customization loading rather than equating one test-local HOME with product ephemerality.
recommended_next_gate: Define one explicit Claude EPHEMERAL_AUTH_PROFILE contract that separates credential continuity from writable cognition/session state.

On the exact supported Claude Code version, compare current flags against a safe-mode candidate while retaining --tools empty, --strict-mcp-config, --no-session-persistence and prompt-history suppression.
Bind pre/post filesystem manifests for HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and relevant project .claude surfaces; derive persistence fields from observed writes rather than constants.
Explicitly account for managed-settings hooks because current Claude Code safe-mode documentation says managed settings policy still applies.
Run the four boundary nodes and aggregate validator on one exact clean authorized Ubuntu runtime before any EPHEMERAL or aggregate runtime promotion.
